hooks.command:
actions_msg=$(gh run list --repo priore/foglifatture --limit 20 --json name,conclusion,createdAt,headBranch 2>/dev/null | jq -r '[.[] | select(.headBranch=="main" and .conclusion=="failure")] as $f | if ($f | length) > 0 then "GitHub Actions: " + (($f | length) | tostring) + " workflow fallito/i su foglifatture (main): " + ([$f[].name] | unique | join(", ")) + ". Controlla con: gh run list --repo priore/foglifatture" else empty end' 2>/dev/null); pr_msg=$(gh pr list --repo priore/foglifatture --json number,title --limit 30 2>/dev/null | jq -r 'if (length) > 0 then "PR aperte su foglifatture (" + (length | tostring) + "): " + ([.[] | "#\(.number) " + .title] | join("; ")) else empty end' 2>/dev/null); msg=""; if [ -n "$actions_msg" ]; then msg="$actions_msg"; fi; if [ -n "$pr_msg" ]; then if [ -n "$msg" ]; then msg="$msg
$pr_msg"; else msg="$pr_msg"; fi; fi; if [ -n "$msg" ]; then jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{systemMessage: $m}'; fi; exit 0

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | { read -r cmd; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '\bgit\s+(commit|push)\b'; then hit=$( (git ls-files; git diff --cached --name-only) | grep -E '(^|/)(config\.json|\.env|[^/]*\.key|[^/]*\.pem)$' ); if [ -n "$hit" ]; then printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"Sensitive file(s) staged/tracked, blocking commit/push:\n%s"}' "$hit"; exit 0; fi; fi; exit 0; }
